manual.point: Optional[x,y] normalized in[0,1],or unknown/uncertain; no anatomical classification from coordinates

conventions.scope: Historical region/terminology lookup; no individualized physiognomic assessment.
conventions.orientation: Software annotation convention,not a Lavater formula: view left_profile means anatomical left side visible. Subject-side labels remain anatomical; frontal viewer labels swap under nonmirrored display and agree under mirrored display. Unknown mirroring remains ambiguous. Profile viewer labels cannot determine anatomical side.
conventions.coordinates: Optional normalized annotation points: x,y in[0,1]. Canonical subject-frame x increases toward anatomical right. Frontal nonmirrored viewer x maps to1-x; mirrored x maps tox. Profile projection is not normalized into a frontal face.
conventions.geometry: User descriptive enums and schematic annotations only; no thresholds,feature detection or geometry-to-trait rules.
conventions.tradition_isolation: No Chinese Mian Xiang,five-element,12-palace,Bridges or Holcroft mappings are borrowed.

boundaries: Geometry never selects historical trait content; region references remain documentary context. Unknown region IDs retained explicitly unsupported. Invalid fields/duplicate JSON keys/nonfinite coordinates rejected.
